programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Det ringer in till skolvecka på hotellet och det är dags för eleverna på Paradise High att visa sina kunskaper. Men, ska man tänka på sin pakt eller på sig själv? Och vad rimmar egentligen på netto?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Tillit växer fram i oväntade allianser, och på andra håll gror svartsjukan. Alla medel verkar vara tillåtna när det gäller att slå in kilar hos paren i motsatt pakt. Dessutom checkar balens kung in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2407

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 504

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 204

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1306

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: När Audrina objuden dyker upp på Heidis födelsedag blir hon snart varse om att Heidi inte är redo att förlåta henne. Lauren, fast besluten att koncentrera sig på jobbet, faller för en charmig ny kille i hennes liv - Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina berättar för Heidi om Spencers vänsterprassel, men Heidi tror inte på henne - förrän hon ser det med egna ögon. Lauren är fortfarande inte säker på om hon är redo för ett nytt förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en paus från Spencer men saknar honom mer än hon hade trott. Lauren ska planera en Teen Vogue-middag, men superpraktikanten Emily från New York tar över.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: När Lauren berättar för Heidi vad hon egentligen tycker om Spencer måste Heidi välja mellan sin bästa vän och sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren inser att hon inte kan lita på sin bästa vän när Heidi sammanför Jen och Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi att flytta in hos honom, men Heidi vet inte vad hon ska göra eller hur hon ska berätta det för sin rumskompis Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag är full av överraskningar när Heidi och Audrina håller en överraskningsfest för henne. Jen försöker sluta fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 och Heidi har stora planer för födelsedagskalaset. Men innan festen bestämmer hon sig för att berätta för Lauren att Spencer vill att de ska flytta ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen blir det spänt när Heidi måste besluta om hon ska flytta ihop med Spencer eller inte. Lauren vänder sig till Audrina när hon vill fylla tomrummet efter sin bästa vän, och Whitney flyger till New York för en intervju.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går inte på Heidis and Spencers inflyttningsfest, efter att ha hört att Heidi spridit rykten om henne. När Lauren och Heidi springer på varandra har de sitt hittills största gräl.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi kommer ännu längre från varandra när Spencer friar till Heidi. Audrina menar allvar med en pojkvän från förr och Lauren återvänder till Laguna Beach för att fråga om råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren försöker hjälpa Audrina att avgöra om Justin har det som krävs av en pojkvän, men Audrina har redan bestämt sig. Heidi märker att det inte alls är kul att vara förlovad och börjar flörta.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Season 4 Reunion

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1104

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Hoffs learns that her new lover is married, and when she tries to break up the relationship, he sexually harasses her until she complains to his boss.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: While trying to infiltrate a high school computer club, Penhall is picked on by a bully.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: When Russell Buckins writes a dangerously revealing magazine article about the Jump Street program, Hanson is suspended and goes gunning for his old friend.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Novel Idea

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Hazard

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: This Should Be Explosive...
programme.desc: Katrina believes her sister Kendra’s boyfriend is a cheater and having sex with her best friend Nay-Nay! Later, John returns to the stage with a shocking update!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?
programme.desc: Michelle needs answers about who hurt her daughter. She will stop at nothing to protect her baby. Will the father James clear his name on Steve's stage?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: DNA: Don't Run From the Results
programme.desc: Roberta suspects that her husband Bryan has been cheating. They both believe the other is cheating. Find out whether these men are really the father on today's Steve Wilkos!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did
programme.desc: Shannan claims Tim fathered her child. He doesn't buy it because he doesn't recall having sex with her! Later, Ayana is furious that her boyfriend Patrick denies their son!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Your Kids Need Their Mom, But You Chose Him

programme.title: COPS

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The 1000th Episode!
programme.desc: On the 1000th episode, we'll bring you all of the crazy confessions, explosive meltdowns, chair throws, funny moments and the heartfelt stories that have made this show special!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Saw Right Through You
programme.desc: Today on Steve Wilkos, Maurice wants to prove to his girlfriend that he's faithful. Plus Chuanhtee says fed up with Ladi's cheating accusations! Watch as the truth is revealed!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: An Explosive DNA Story
programme.desc: Teneal and Richard are telling different tales, each alleging the other is unfit to parent! The truth will come down to a lie detector test, and the results will be shocking!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Devil Dad
programme.desc: Today Danny is finally ready to face the missing man in his life and get answers to lifelong questions. Steven offers a number of excuses for not seeing his son, but can he redeem himself?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Two years ago, Latisha and her boyfriend were found shot to death in their car. Latisha’s mother Nancy believes her ex-husband Kenneth was involved. Who is responsible for their deaths?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: 15yr old Chuck returns home from school to find his mother, Betty Limbrick, shot dead on the floor. Evidence points to a robbery gone wrong, but Kenda uncovers a plot almost too shocking to believe.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A seemingly random attack leaves Mary Moebus dead, and police flummoxed by a daunting field of suspects. But when Lt Joe Kenda uncovers a cache of new evidence, he realizes someone’s been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Nine-Year-Old Hostage
programme.desc: A hostage situation puts Sgt. Joe Kenda and his team to the test, as they try to save a family without getting shot themselves.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Settle the Score
programme.desc: When Johnny Crawford is killed in his easy chair, police are perplexed to learn he may have been shot over a musical instrument. It soon becomes clear the young man wasn’t killed for his own sins.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Spy Who Killed Me
programme.desc: Housewife Elsie Jennes is found dead in the basement of her burning home. Lt Joe Kenda has no leads until Elsie’s son, William, turns up in a police station over 50 miles away with a story to tell.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Evil Encounter

programme.title: Teens Who Kill

programme.title: Teens Who Kill
programme.desc: Brothers Connor and Brandon Doran, and their friend Simon Evans, were convicted of the murder of Kevin Bennett, a local of Walton in Liverpool, in 2014.

programme.title: Teens Who Kill
